policy_cases: Continuing the same song counts once
Explicit same-song Save As does not refund usage

limitations: Same-composition identity uses Live Set metadata, explicit user attestation and the Bridge fresh-set signal; this is not perfect detection of every rewritten composition.
AI usage estimates are checked between provider calls, not reserved as an exact hard spending ceiling before concurrent calls.
Existing-song revisions remain subject to the separate AI allowance.
A potentially applied or interrupted music write does not automatically refund a song credit.
This policy release did not perform an actual customer audio audition or create a real Ableton song.
